productName: FormTimer — Native Exam Cutoff & Session Timer for Google Forms

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of running timed quizzes and automatic submission cutoffs in Google Forms getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With FormTimer, One-Click Duration Presets & Exact Deadline Cutoffs runs right where you already work. Uses Your Official Native Google Form Link and Custom Closed-Form Message & Timestamp Audit—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle running timed quizzes and automatic submission cutoffs in Google Forms, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch FormTimer in action: Choose 15, 30, 45, 60, or 90-minute exam windows—or schedule an exact date and time—to close form submissions automatically on the dot. Zero external wrapper websites or iframe redirects. Students open the normal Google Form inside Google Classroom with zero authentication errors. Plus, display a clear, tailored message the moment time expires and inspect exact submission timestamps inside your connected response sheet. Student names, emails, and test scores never touch an external proctoring cloud—and you never hit a mid-finals monthly test quota. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
